es.boilerplate: HS Dev es el estudio de desarrollo web y mantenimiento WordPress del grupo HS Digital. en.positioning: The web development and WordPress maintenance studio that tells you, without jargon, what you get, how it's maintained and what happens if something breaks.
taglines: Websites that work. And keep working.
A website isn't built and forgotten. It's looked after.
If something breaks, you know who to write to and what happens next.
en.heroLead: We build your website in WordPress or custom code, connect it to your tools and keep it up to date: backups, updates and security. If something breaks, you know who to write to and what happens next.

problem.title: A website isn't built and forgotten. It's looked after.
points: Nobody knows if there's a backup
When something breaks, you don't know who to call
problem.answer: We sort it out and keep it maintained

not: Heavy page builders and plugin bloat

tone.why: A business owner who has never heard of PHP must understand what they get and how it's maintained.
Informal 'you', short sentences, no jargon without a one-line explanation.

tone.principle: Say what happens if it breaks.
tone.why: Always say who to contact and what happens next, with no invented uptime or speed figures.

doDont.do: We take a backup before every change.
If something breaks, you know who to write to and what happens next.
We update plugins after testing them.
doDont.dont: We manage your stack and dependencies.

services.name: Website and WordPress maintenance
services.text: We update WordPress, plugins and theme after testing them, keep backups off your server, watch for downtime and security issues, and respond when something breaks. No lock-in.

services.name: Hacked website recovery
services.text: We clean your WordPress, close the door they got in through, and set up backups and monitoring so it doesn't happen again.

services.name: Custom WordPress development
services.text: Your site with its own theme and blocks you edit yourself, with no heavy page builders or extra plugins.

services.name: WooCommerce shops
services.text: Catalogue, payments, shipping and taxes set up properly, connected to your invoicing.

services.name: WordPress speed optimisation
services.text: We find what's slowing your site down and fix it, measuring before and after so you can see the change.

services.name: Integrations and APIs
services.text: We connect your site to your CRM, invoicing, payments, bookings or email marketing so nobody copies data by hand.

products.name: HS Consent
products.text: Cookie banner for Spanish and EU sites: rejecting is as easy as accepting, categories, Google Consent Mode v2 and a consent log without IP addresses.

products.name: HS Calculator
products.text: Quote calculator for service businesses: visitors pick options step by step, see a live estimate, leave their details and get a quote page and an email.

products.name: HS Leads
products.text: Lead forms for small-business sites: spam protection without captchas or cookies, a lead inbox, email notifications and forwarding to a webhook or CRM with retries.

products.name: HS Woo España
products.text: Invoice data for Spanish WooCommerce shops: a validated NIF/NIE/CIF field and an «¿Necesitas factura?» option at checkout.

products.name: HS Studio
products.text: A fast, modern block theme for small businesses: style variations, section styles and 20+ patterns. No page builder, no jQuery.

audience: SMEs with a WordPress site nobody maintains

en.description: HS Dev is the HS Digital group's web development and WordPress maintenance studio for small businesses in Madrid, Bilbao and across Spain. We build your website, connect it to your tools and keep it up to date.
en.boilerplate: HS Dev is the web development and WordPress maintenance studio of the HS Digital group. We build WordPress and custom websites, WooCommerce shops, integrations and web apps, and maintain them with backups, tested updates and security. We explain it without jargon, with no lock-in, and if something breaks you know who to contact. We also publish Spanish-language WordPress plugins (GPL code).
